name: ericwurth
description: Reusable skills and plugins for Claude. Skills are self-contained folders you can copy or upload; plugins install through the marketplace.

plugins.name: skill-evolution
plugins.description: Evolves your other skills on a schedule — finds a real technique gap, proves the gain, sandboxes it, and gates promotion on your sign-off.

plugins.name: memory-vault
plugins.description: A file-based, human-gated memory system for AI agents: deliberate writes, gated promotion, quiet reads, cold-path maintenance.

plugins.name: rulegate
plugins.description: Makes project rules bind instead of decay — compiles requests into rule-compliant plans, gates execution scope, and keeps an evidence ledger.

plugins.name: resumebot
plugins.description: A job-search operating system: master resume, targeting coach, Excel tracker, board scans, tailored packets, apply queue, email sync, and interview prep.

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: A senior-resource agent that owns problems end-to-end and reports in decision-queue format.
